full_page.content:
1934, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 171 Cont.
Jan. 18 Ed. Warring - 58 - of Stanton, Michigan - out home & work - Simple, too credulous etc.
Ruth Long - 20 - mentally weak .. .
Clarence D. Gaugh - 58 - non Cath. in hospital 3 yrs. - lung col- lapsed "absolutely hopeless" when call on phone to enroll - last Sunday - slept that night. Now wife & family thank - Hope of re- covery - Enrolled To-night at 10 o'c
Grace McCarlen - 20 - operation Wed.
Thomas Thorton - 38 - T.B.
Mrs. Martha Melissa - 33 - like a stroke 3 yrs. ago - memory also weakened.
24 Adolph Bollmam - 24 - eczema - Mrs. Andres - 50 - fears spine trouble
H. Mary McPhail - 45 - qoiter & stiff limbs - kneeling very difficult Grace McCartin .. Family Relief Fund - Card pt. 26 John Cronin T. B. 3 yrs. - now arthritis Mrs. Moran - caught in wringer . ..
Page 172 Jan. 24 Leonard Norbut - 8 - spinal trouble - parents "Orthodox united - once a year to H. Com.
Mrs. Jes. Fraser - 55 - presbiterian of England - losing mind - son here a convert asks prayers.
Ray Cole - 39 - methodest - coach-driver backing up on Jan. 15th crushed boy of 8 who died in 5 hours. Cole seems to be in every way a conscientious man. Trial of case to take place Jan. 31st - en- rolls to-night in Ser. Mass Assoc'n is advised to be earnest in God's service, etc, if ....
John Rynn - 31 - of Toledo, 0. T.B. broke down trying to keep his mother.
